programme.sub-title: Sin derecho a nada; Casting para matrimonio

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Despiden al stripper José porque Jeffry se le lanzó encima y rompieron las tuberías del baño. Sofía es drogadicta y dejó a su hijo al cuidado de su abuela, pero ahora reclama la custodia.
programme.sub-title: Chiquito rompecorazones; Solo quedan tres venas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Patricia busca la custodia de su nieta con autismo porque la madre quiere tratarla a golpes. Geraldine se quedó encerrada en el ascensor de su edificio con un depredador sexual.
programme.sub-title: Paida lajin; Acoso en el elevador

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por venganza, Wendy creó perfiles falsos de Fernanda y puso sus datos en páginas eróticas. La sobrina de John tiene la hemoglobina baja y se desmaya en el colegio, él sospecha de su hermana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Bárbara encontró a su esposo en la cama con un hombre mientras vestía la ropa interior de ella. En una fábrica de salchichas hallaron un dedo de la esposa desaparecida del dueño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El esposo de Luisa la dejó tener sexo con otros hombres, pero se cansó y le cerró la vagina con pegamento. Un hombre invirtió en el negocio de un amigo y fue preso por narcotráfico, pero su mujer no lo ayudó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quieren desalojarlo de la finca ubicada en unas tierras en las que su gente ha vivido por tres generaciones. En otro caso, lo que hace para evitar el alzhéimer provoca grandes problemas en su vida cotidiana.
programme.sub-title: Sal de mi tierra, indio; La obsesión

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nadia y Camilo fueron al casino, ganaron 200 mil dólares y ahora se pelean por el dinero. Por otro lado, José se casó con Kelly por papeles, pero ella tiene un hijo que impone las reglas.
programme.sub-title: La suerte es mía; Fantasía bestial

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tania cumplió el deseo de su hijo: lo embalsamó y lo expuso como estatua en la sala. La esposa de Alberto murió asfixiada al practicarle sexo oral a Carlos, un hombre con un miembro inusual.
programme.sub-title: La última voluntad; Ahogada por manguera negra

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Aniuska descubre que su esposo desaparecido y su hija están con una mujer que resultó ser su hermana. Como su sobrino y su hermano fueron víctimas de un musulmán, ella usa la pornovenganza.
programme.sub-title: Niña caprichosa; Porno a la musulmana

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cuando Juan tiene sexo con su esposa le hace cosquillas, y ella no lo soporta. Alejandro denunció a su amigo Antonio en inmigración porque es indocumentado, y le dieron su puesto en la empresa.
programme.sub-title: Cosquillas torturadoras; Por su culpa caí

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un padre descubre que sus hijos en realidad no lo son y quiere quedarse con el dinero de la herencia de la madre. Profesora expone a un alumno que le preguntó si amar a otro hombre está bien.
programme.sub-title: Hijos traidores; La educación de doble vía

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lenin cocina a domicilio y transmite en vivo, su clienta salió semidesnuda y el marido lo golpeó. Marian se casó con un señor por el dinero y los papeles, pero después descubrió que él es su abuelo.
programme.sub-title: Sexo y golpe en la cocina; Casada con abuelo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Encuentra a su abuela casada con el ex de la cuidadora, quien está acusado de robar bienes de ancianos. Tiene arresto domiciliario, pero la convivencia con su exmarido se volvió insoportable.
programme.sub-title: Último día de Felicia; Arresto domiciliario

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El papá cobró una indeminzación porque su hija se perdió en el terminal y la mamá exige el dinero. Andrea quiere que su esposo se declare inhabilitado por un problema en la pierna,pero él se niega.
programme.sub-title: Vividora con derecho; Primero muerto que deshabilitado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José lleva a la madre a la funeraria porque supuestamente le quedan cuatro horas de vida y él tiene que viajar. Karen piensa que su esposo abusa de su hija, pero el hombre sospecha del primo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paola exige la custodia del hijo que tiene con Dennis, el niño es víctima de burlas porque promociona productos de maquillaje. Ilka e Irma juegan a los dados la tutela de sus cuatro hijos.
programme.sub-title: Mercado abusivo; Dos más dos igual a cinco

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hermana e hija de Gladis se casaron y viven en su casa, ella exige que desalojen. María tiene multiorgasmos involuntarios provocados vía telepática por un mexicano, su marido se aprovecha.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Vino a EE.UU. a trabajar por los papeles, pero su empleadora no está satisfecha. Lucy tiene cáncer terminal, quiere desalojar a su hijo y a su nieto de la casa para venderla y poder viajar.
programme.sub-title: Cachifa en jaula de oro; Sin piedad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lisa demanda a Rodrigo, su pareja, él padece cáncer y decidió repartir sus bienes, algo que ella no considera correcto. Nelson pide compensación de su hermanastra por darle shots de oxy.
programme.sub-title: Dos meses de vida; Oxy Shots

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daphne no supera la muerte de su hija. Cree que reencarnó en la muñeca preferida de la niña. Sam quiere ir al ejército y someterse a una cirugía para cambiar de sexo, pero debe dejar a su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tres mujeres embarazadas del mismo hombre reclaman una casa familiar, alegan que no tienen a dónde ir. En otro caso, una niña goza del don de la premonición, alguien dice lo que va a pasar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio regresa a México y se lleva una sorpresa cuando llega a la bodega, por lo que decide cambiarse el rostro. El Cabo le dice al Chema que él se encarga de encontrar a Casillas con ayuda de Irina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas se somete a cirugía estética, pero el procedimiento se complica y Heriberto pierde el control. Rutila le miente a Ximena por temor al Turco: le dice que extraña a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El detective Mejía organiza la cacería de Aurelio, en medio de confrontaciones armadas. Casillas muestra su amor y deseo de proteger a su familia, así como su faceta de mujeriego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio resulta herido al salvar a su hija en el atentado, y él y Chacorta logran escapar en una de las camionetas. Escobar le pide a Casillas sacar a su familia de Colombia, pero él no le cumple lo prometido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mejía captura a Casillas y lo sentencia a pagar por todo lo que ha hecho. Guadalupe le informa a Mónica que arrestaron a Aurelio; ella lo visita en prisión y le pide que se marchen juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Unos presos intentan asesinar a Aurelio, pero él se defiende. Explota una bomba en el carro en el que viajaban Ximena y sus hijos. Casillas sube a un helicóptero para su extradición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas recibe una llamada de Ximena, quien le dice que tanto ella como los niños están bien. Aurelio es liberado y se reúne con su familia; decide casarse y establece una alianza con sus enemigos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se lleva a cabo el matrimonio entre Ximena y Aurelio. El Norteño se da cuenta del atentado en contra de la novia, persigue al Jaibo y le informa a Casillas de sus sospechas sobre Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Isidro que sabe que fue él quien mandó poner la bomba en el auto donde viajaban Ximena y los niños. Mónica enfrenta a Casillas, despertando sospechas en su esposa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Guadalupe no cree que la muerte de su hermano Isidro fue un infarto: asegura que Aurelio está involucrado. Casillas les advierte a los suyos que se apoderará del negocio de los colombianos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice al Cabo que viajará con ellos a Colombia, pero Guadalupe y Mónica también llegan para acompañarlos. El coronel Jiménez da órdenes de vigilar a Mejía y a Eugenia, su novia periodista.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se ofrece a ayudar a Lupe para rescatar a Mónica, pero él se niega, muy molesto. El Cabo le dice a Casillas que las cosas se complicaron: se preparan para el enfrentamiento.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Ximena que no se le ocurra hacerle algo al bebé que espera, ante sus reclamos. Compra un 727 para transportar la droga, mientras él y sus hombres viajan en otro avión por seguridad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El detective Mejía organiza la cacería de Aurelio, en medio de confrontaciones armadas. Casillas muestra su amor y deseo de proteger a su familia, así como su faceta de mujeriego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio resulta herido al salvar a su hija en el atentado, y él y Chacorta logran escapar en una de las camionetas. Escobar le pide a Casillas sacar a su familia de Colombia, pero él no le cumple lo prometido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mejía captura a Casillas y lo sentencia a pagar por todo lo que ha hecho. Guadalupe le informa a Mónica que arrestaron a Aurelio; ella lo visita en prisión y le pide que se marchen juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Unos presos intentan asesinar a Aurelio, pero él se defiende. Explota una bomba en el carro en el que viajaban Ximena y sus hijos. Casillas sube a un helicóptero para su extradición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo le pregunta a Aurelio quién es Letrudo, y se une a los planes para vengarse con Chacorta y el Turco. Víctor llega al estudio de grabación para ver cómo va Matilde con el tema del disco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La guerrilla retiene a Aurelio y Socorro, y él le pide a Chacorta que lo rescate cuando las negociaciones se complican. El Tijera le dice a Guadalupe que Casillas recuperó la droga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Oscar obliga a Dobladillo a hablar por teléfono con Canica, quien le da la ubicación del comandante Macario, con quien debe de estar Aurelio. Mejía y Jiménez contactan a la agente Leonor Ballesteros.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le presenta a Mónica a la nueva piloto que contrató, pero ella la hace sentir incómoda. Ximena sorprende a su hijo Heriberto en una situación sospechosa con la tía Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le avisa al coronel Jiménez del nuevo cargamento que llega de Colombia, y le entrega la foto del Pombo para que sepa a quién deben arrestar, pero Leonor resulta herida en la operación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Roxana le pide dinero a Guadalupe, pero él la toma por la fuerza y se aprovecha de ella. Mónica indaga sobre los contactos de su hermano. El coronel Jiménez le cuenta a Doris sobre su ascenso.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jiménez recibe un regalo especial. Chacorta llega a una colonia y hace un estudio para el expendio de la droga, habla con Aurelio y le dice que es una buena oportunidad de negocio en el país.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio tiene controlado todo el mercado del país con la venta en las colonias, y le pide a Irina que lo ponga en contacto con el presidente. Ella dice que con él no, pero sí con su primo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía le dice a Jiménez que deben desmantelar la red de distribución que tienen los Casillas en las colonias. Los Villalobos llaman para pedir una cita con Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mejía propone que Aurelio pierda su anonimato. Mónica está furiosa porque Casillas no le contesta el celular. Ponte le dice a Marco Mejía que ya tiene a sus hombres listos para la operación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jiménez da luz verde para ir por Casillas, y Mejía comienza un operativo para desmantelar toda la organización. Mónica le exige a Aurelio que active el negocio con Guadalupe.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Villalobos se enteran de lo que sucede con Casillas y quieren aprovechar para sacarlo del negocio. Aurelio le pide a Chacorta que les dé un susto a los periodistas para vengarse.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo le pregunta a Aurelio quién es Letrudo, y se une a los planes para vengarse con Chacorta y el Turco. Víctor llega al estudio de grabación para ver cómo va Matilde con el tema del disco.

programme.title: Turning Points in American History
programme.desc: The North American continent is never the same after the Great Epidemic of 1617; it wipes out nearly 90 percent of Native Americans and allows British colonization to proceed virtually unchallenged; the defining characteristics of a turning point.

programme.title: Turning Points in American History
programme.desc: How and why does a democratic America become a slaveholding society; exploring this paradox from its origins in 1619; slaves arrive at Jamestown; the influence of Bacon's Rebellion in 1676; the expansion of slavery throughout the South in the 1800s.
programme.sub-title: 1619 Land of the Free? Slavery Begins

programme.title: Turning Points in American History
programme.desc: Roger Williams's efforts to establish freedom of religion, a somewhat forgotten story from early colonial America; religious life in the early Massachusetts settlements; Williams's controversial ideas; his influence on religious freedom in America.

programme.title: Turning Points in American History
programme.desc: A symbolic expression of the idea that all are welcome in America takes place in 1654; the Dutch West India Company allows Jews from Brazil to settle in New Amsterdam; a gateway to understanding immigration as a central theme in American history.

programme.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: Abraham Lincoln is born with little more than his natural talents; his father is more than contented with the life of a classic Jeffersonian farmer; the Lincolns move from Indiana to Illinois; Abraham strikes out on his own and never looks back.

programme.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: Lincoln's entry into politics coincides with the emergence of a new national political party, the Whigs; Lincoln at the forefront of Whig agitation to improve business; his own business ventures flop; he takes up law in Springfield, Illinois.

programme.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: Through his law partner, John Todd Stuart, Lincoln meets and marries Mary Todd in 1842; he wins the election to Congress in 1846, but his term is undistinguished; Lincoln returns to a life of domestic unhappiness; substantial success as an attorney.

programme.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: Lincoln's folksiness is a shield he rarely lets down; many see him as an introverted, slightly aloof lawyer; he dislikes wanna-be aristocrats and is a tremendous reader; he believes in God, but not the God of any formal religion.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: The lands around the central Turkish plateau historically "face" two ways; the western and southern shores are drawn to Greece and Europe; the mountain-ringed interior is linked to Iran and Asia proper.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: Neolithic Anatolians are among the first farmers and herders, dwelling in villages with sophisticated technology and organization; they learn to write and build palaces and cities from the Sumerians to the south.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: Beginning as invaders from the Balkans, the Indo-European people called the Hittites overrun Anatolia's core with their war chariots; they create a dynasty that rivals the Egypt of Ramses II.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: Hittite kings become the first of many conquerors who leave their mark on the land; near their ritual capital of Hattusas, they carve from rock an open-air shrine to their thousands of gods; shortly thereafter, Hattusas is sacked and abandoned.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: What archeologists actually do; the nature and scope of their work; misconceptions about the field; tracing the history of archeology, from its beginnings with the ancient Babylonian king Nabonidus to archeological luminaries of the 20th century.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Traveling to the sites of Pompeii and Herculaneum, which are destroyed by the 79 A.D. eruption of Mount Vesuvius; the history of their excavation; the preservation of buildings, objects and human remains; discovering details of ancient Roman life.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Following the exploits of Heinrich Schliemann as he looks for Homer's Troy; learning about his dig through nine stratified cities; the finds; the debates over which city is Troy; tracing subsequent work at the site; examining the conclusions.
programme.sub-title: Schliemann and His Successors at Troy

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: The history of finds in Mesopotamia; the 19th-century unearthing of the Assyrian palaces at Nimrud and Nineveh, with their libraries of cuneiform texts; contemplating the 20th-century discovery of the treasures of the "Death Pits of Ur".

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: The reasons to study the ancient Greeks; their iconic art and architecture, philosophy, religion and inventions of drama and democracy; the Greeks in cultural, historical and linguistic terms; the development and character of Greek civilization.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Human habitation on the mainland and islands of Greece; the Bronze Age cultures of the Cycladic islands; the Minoan civilization centered on Crete; the Mycenaean civilization and its monumental architecture; Mycenae's connection with the Trojan War.
programme.sub-title: Bronze Age Greece: Minoans and Myceneans

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Greece's Dark Age is an era of restricted trade and a breakdown of centralized power; the achievements of this epoch include iron technology, the Greek alphabet and the Olympic Games; Greece's geographical expansion; creation of city-states.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Greece's Classical Age is an astonishing period of human accomplishment; defining events of the period; the 479 B.C.E. defeat of the Persians; the period of the Peloponnesian War; the emergence of Macedonia as a great power; Alexander's exploits.
programme.sub-title: Classical Greece: The Age of Pericles

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: The Christianization of the Roman world is one of the most important turning points in Western civilization; the issues to consider and the scholars whose seminal theories serve as the gateways to the course's different lines of exploration.
programme.sub-title: Religious Conflict in the Roman World

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: How are pagan gods worshiped in ancient Rome; using evidence both literary and archaeological, grasping the diverse assortment of religious practices in an empire that ranges from Britain to Egypt; comprising a fifth of the world's population.
programme.sub-title: Gods and Their Cities in the Roman Empire

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Rome's first emperor, Augustus, establishes an institution to venerate an emperor's spirit; which then resides as a god on Mount Olympus; how emperors take pains to deify their predecessors to position themselves next among that honored line.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Mystery cults are believed to be the worship to a particular god; the choice to join and undergo an initiation rite; specific cults and the question of whether they do form a bridge between paganism and Christianity, as some scholars maintain.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Exploring the palaces of Saddam Hussein; discovering how he calls upon the ancient Egyptians and Babylonians for inspiration; how the architecture changes over time in response to threats from Iran and the United States.

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Traveling back to the 14th century B.C. in Egypt; how the Malkata Palace represents a microcosm of Egypt; architectural details reveal insights about religious rituals how pharaohs attempt to assert their domination over others.
programme.sub-title: Malkata Palace: Pharaoh, Foreigners, and Gods

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Akhenaten shifts Egypt's capital to Amarna; how his worship of the sun disk defines an era built on temple crops, sacrifices and obedience to the pharaoh; how relocating his seat of power helps Akhenaten wrestle authority away from religious leaders.
programme.sub-title: Amarna: Palace of the First Sun King

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Studying Bronze Age Crete; the myth of Daedalus and his labyrinth symbolizes Crete's location at the intersection of multiple cultures; discovering the Phaistos Palace, the site of extravagant religious rituals and entertainment spectacles.
programme.sub-title: Phaistos: Palaces Between Asia and Europe

programme.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Exploring the Palace of Nestor, a complex centered around the throne room; the ancient styles the Mycenaeans develop to bring these elaborate structures to life; what the arrangement of rooms reveals about how royals live and maintain control.
programme.sub-title: Palace of Nestor at Pylos and Bronze Age Greece

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Examining the visual nature of Roman society and the key role of spectacular display; ranging from its center in the Roman Forum to its frontiers.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: This lecture provides a chronological, thematic and geographical framework; understanding the visual components of the Roman Empire; especially how different forms of governments and their citizens affect their art, architecture and public display.
programme.sub-title: A Brief Survey of the Roman Empire

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Learning the fundamental role of Rome's military in expanding the empire through conquest; creating and projecting the image of Roman power; introducing non-Romans to Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Conquest provides a reason for triumphal processions, sacrifices, games and other grand spectacles; it also allows for public and religious participation in a reinforcement of Roman values and identity.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: Touring the palaces of Rome's powerful rulers; seeing how power and culture are displayed in forms that are admired and imitated by lower social classes.

programme.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire
programme.desc: As a stage for political, religious and social display, the houses of Roman elites celebrate Roman virtues and cultural identity; reinforcing to social equals and inferiors the influence of the inhabitants.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Garrett G. Fagan addresses the importance of studying battles and surveys the changing scholarly approach to the subject; he concludes by looking at different definitions of warfare, particularly the operational and social-constructivist models.
programme.sub-title: Why Study Battles? What Is War?

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Three types of evidence shed light on the origins of warfare; human remains bearing evidence of trauma; artifacts that function primarily as weapons; fortifications or depictions of warriors painted on cave walls; their interpretations are tricky.

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Written records first become available in the historical era; evidence reconstructs the conventions and conditions of warfare among the first cities in Sumer circa the 30th century B.C.; exploring the nature of Sumerian armies and battle tactics.
programme.sub-title: Sumer, Akkad, and Early Mesopotamian Warfare

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Evidence of warfare in ancient Egypt is ambiguous, but it is much more plentiful in later periods; the pharaoh's role is increasingly that of a war leader; Egyptian warfare is transformed by the introduction of the chariot.
programme.sub-title: Egyptian Warfare From the Old to New Kingdoms

programme.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World
programme.desc: In the New Kingdom of Egypt, one gets the first fully recorded battle in history, the Battle of Megiddo; covering the later Battle of Kadesh, which is attested in both Egyptian and Hittite accounts.
programme.sub-title: The Battles of Megiddo and Kadesh

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradiya (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

programme.title: Webs
programme.desc: Electrical workers discover an underground portal leading to a parallel world where spider people rule Chicago.

programme.title: Slither
programme.desc: Wheelsy is a small town where not much happens and everyone minds his own business. No one notices when evil slips in quietly but, when people find mutilated livestock and a woman goes missing, Sheriff Bill Pardy (Nathan Fillion) discovers an alien organism that threatens to devour all life on Earth.

programme.title: Beneath
programme.desc: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

programme.title: My Little Eye
programme.desc: As part of an Internet reality show, five people sign up to spend six months in a mansion while cameras film constantly. If each person stays the entire length of the show, everyone walks away with $1 million -- a premise that seems too good to be true. Strange things start happening, like the arrival of mysterious, disturbing packages, filled with items like guns and morbid letters. After an unexpected death, the participants start to question the true reality of this experiment.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruits Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

programme.title: Missing Link
programme.desc: Upon returning to his camp from a nearby watering hole, a half-simian/half-human herbivore (Michael Gambon) -- the titular "missing link" between ape and man -- discovers his entire clan, friends and family have been killed by Stone Age humans. Thus begins a long search for others of his kind. As he traverses the African continent avoiding humans and looking for clues about his own species, he also befriends animals and learns about the world in which he is the last of his kind.

programme.title: Rage of the Yeti
programme.desc: Two adventurers (David Chokachi, Matthew Kevin Anderson) embark on a mission to rescue trapped researchers from vicious snow-beasts.

programme.title: Ghost Dad
programme.desc: Elliot Hopper (Bill Cosby) is a widowed single dad who is utterly fixated on his family's financial well-being. He spends all his time working to secure a crucial business deal that would put his accounts in the black. However, this leaves his three children pining for his attention. After a fatal car accident, Hopper -- now a ghost -- must clinch the deal from the afterlife to secure his children's futures. Along the way, he discovers all the bonding he'd been missing when he was alive.

programme.title: Radioland Murders
programme.desc: The secretary at radio station WBN, Penny Henderson (Mary Stuart Masterson) is frantically trying to keep things in order as a broadcast goes on the air. Chaos breaks loose, however, when a series of murders occurs in the building, accompanied by an enigmatic voice over the airwaves. Penny's writer husband, Roger (Brian Benben), tries to deduce who the killer is, but he also happens to be the prime suspect. As he evades the law, Roger gets closer to uncovering the identity of the murderer.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Shaun is a 30-something loser with a dull, easy existence. When he's not working at the electronics store, he lives with his slovenly best friend, Ed, in a small flat on the outskirts of London. The only unpredictable element in his life is his girlfriend, Liz, who wishes desperately for Shaun to grow up and be a man. When the town is inexplicably overrun with zombies, Shaun must rise to the occasion and protect both Liz and his mother.

programme.title: The Munsters
programme.desc: Lily is a typical 150-year-old lovelorn vampire who's looking for the man of her nightmares -- until she lays her eyes on Herman, a 7-foot-tall green experiment with a heart of gold. It's love at first shock as these two ghouls fall fangs over feet for each other in a Transylvanian romance. Unfortunately, it's not all smooth sailing in the cemetery as Lily's father has other plans for his beloved daughter's future, and they don't involve her new bumbling beau.

programme.title: Missing Link
programme.desc: Upon returning to his camp from a nearby watering hole, a half-simian/half-human herbivore (Michael Gambon) -- the titular "missing link" between ape and man -- discovers his entire clan, friends and family have been killed by Stone Age humans. Thus begins a long search for others of his kind. As he traverses the African continent avoiding humans and looking for clues about his own species, he also befriends animals and learns about the world in which he is the last of his kind.

programme.title: Rage of the Yeti
programme.desc: Two adventurers (David Chokachi, Matthew Kevin Anderson) embark on a mission to rescue trapped researchers from vicious snow-beasts.

When Darren finally comes home, the Turners must decide if they're willing to face one more battle -- the fight to save their marriage.

programme.title: Belle and the Beast

Meanwhile, the Monster (Boris Karloff) remains on the run from those who wish to destroy him without understanding that his intentions are generally good despite his lack of socialization and self-control.

Sheriff Wade Parents (James Brolin) is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett (John Marley), is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren (Kathleen Lloyd), are endangered.

programme.desc: Remnants of a mysterious animal have come to light in a remote jungle, and a group of scientists intends to determine if the find is an anomaly or evidence of an undiscovered beast. To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

programme.title: The Curse of the Werewolf
programme.desc: A man with brutal and macabre origins, Leon Corledo (Oliver Reed) was raised in the home of Don Alfredo Corledo (Clifford Evans), his kind and loving adopted father. When he leaves Don Alfredo to find work, Leon discovers that he has increasingly violent urges. Although these tendencies are calmed by Leon's love for the beautiful Christina (Catherine Feller), he ultimately cannot contain his curse and transforms into a werewolf, terrorizing the Spanish countryside.

programme.title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
programme.desc: A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

programme.title: The Deadly Mantis
programme.desc: A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

programme.title: Dr. Cyclops
programme.desc: To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel (Albert Dekker) invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

programme.title: Dracula
programme.desc: Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.

programme.title: Dracula's Daughter
programme.desc: Although Count Dracula was destroyed by Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan), who is now being tried for his murder, Dracula's daughter, the Countess Marya Zaleska (Gloria Holden), is still alive -- and her father's death has brought her no closer to eradicating her vampiric thirst for blood. When attempts to free herself of the disease fail, she turns to psychiatrist Dr. Garth (Otto Kruger) for assistance, but soon finds herself struggling with the desire to make him one of the undead as well.

programme.title: The Evil of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Dr. Frankenstein (Peter Cushing) returns destitute to his home village to recommence his experimental research into the reanimation of dead tissue, and stumbles upon his old monster suspended in ice. Though he revives the creature, Frankenstein must seek the help of hypnotist Zoltan (Peter Woodthorpe) to repair its mind. Zoltan then assumes control of the monster, using him to wreak havoc. But when Frankenstein tries to regain power over his creation, he becomes Zoltan's next target.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
programme.desc: Lawrence Stewart Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) is plagued by a physical oddity that turns him into a crazed werewolf after sundown. His desire to rid himself of this ailment leads him to the castle owned by mad scientist Dr. Frankenstein. Frankenstein, it turns out, is now dead, yet Talbot believes that the scientist's daughter, Baroness Elsa Frankenstein (Ilona Massey), can help him. However, his quest to right himself puts him on a collision course with Frankenstein's monster (Bela Lugosi).

programme.title: The Frozen Ghost
programme.desc: When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

Leading the pack is 2015 Monte Carlo Main Event champion Adrian Mateos, facing off against poker heavyweights Mikita Badziakouski, László Bujtas, and Marius Gierse, plus wildcards Kent Staahle and Mikalai Vaskaboinikau. With life-changing money on the line, who will claim the prestigious title?

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 1 (ME1)-After a three-year hiatus, the prestigious EPT Monte Carlo €5,000 Main Event returns in spectacular fashion. Day 2 brings together poker's biggest names, including high-stakes specialist Patrik Antonius, World Champion Koray Aldemir, Italian ace Mustapha Kanit, and trailblazing two-time EPT champion Victoria Coren-Mitchell. The battle for poker immortality begins.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 2 (ME2)-Tension mounts as the money bubble approaches in Monte Carlo's Main Event. With 159 players set to cash for at least €8,690, every decision matters. EPT legends Patrik Antonius and Davidi Kitai command the feature table while 2019 PSPC champion Ramon Colillas holds the chip lead. Who will survive the bubble and who will go home empty-handed?

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 3 (ME3)-The money bubble has burst, but for seasoned pro Ole Schemion-who has earned over $5 million in Monte Carlo alone-a minimum cash isn't enough. He faces a formidable challenge from French star Gaëlle Baumann and online legend Jussi Nevanlinna at the feature table. With real money now guaranteed, the gloves come off.

programme.title: European Poker Tour

With over €41,000 already locked up, the stakes couldn't be higher as players fight for their place at the final table of nine. Every hand could be the difference between glory and heartbreak.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 6 (ME6)-Nine players remain, but only six will advance to the final day with a shot at nearly €1 million and poker immortality. Can PSPC champion Ramon Colillas extend his remarkable run to another major final table, or will his epic journey end just short of the ultimate prize?

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 7 (ME7)-The moment of truth arrives at the EPT Monte Carlo final table. Six players-two businessmen, one qualifier, and three seasoned professionals-wage the ultimate battle for almost €1 million and the coveted EPT trophy. After days of intense competition, only one can claim poker's most prestigious prize.
